title: SSRQ Online — Sammlung Schweizerischer Rechtsquellen / Collection des sources du droit suisse
notes: SSRQ is Switzerland's critical edition series of medieval/early modern legal sources, published in XML/TEI online since 2019 (Omeka S) and now also on the new 'editio' platform; the harvested origins are Zurich volumes of the Neue Folge (e.g. 'SSRQ ZH_NF_I_2_1 (1452-1637, 222 docs)', 'SSRQ ZH_NF_II_11 (1458-1696, 124 docs)'). The old domain ssrq-sdsr.ch has been renamed to ssrq-sds-fds.ch (the .sdsr URLs no longer resolve); TEI data is published on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10878757) and by the GitHub org SSRQ-SDS-FDS. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Law Sources Foundation of the Swiss Jurists' Society (SSRQ), editorial office at the Universität Zürich (Historisches Seminar)
license_note: Includes CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Licences or rights differ by text, corpus or editorial layer; consult the source terms for the selected material.
